question: How does training an AI brain on your complete business data differ from using generic AI agents like Grokbot?
transcript_excerpt: If you train your AI brain on everything—your emails, text messages, calendar events, sales calls, Zoom meetings—it builds an entire infrastructure and understanding around your business.
